attributes.board_name: Mississippi State Department of Health – Professional Licensure (Occupational Therapy Advisory Council)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved by MSOTA, AOTA (incl. other state associations), NBCOT, AMA, APTA, ASHA, accredited universities, or any US OT licensing authority; unapproved courses only after Department review. At least 13 hours live face-to-face (live webinars accepted if the certificate says live), of which at least 6 directly related to clinical OT practice; up to 7 non-live (home study, video, internet). Pre-approved presentations (1 h + 1 h prep, max 30%); academic courses (1 semester hour = 15 hours, max 50%; advanced OT degree coursework may meet the full requirement); publications (max 3); Level I/II fieldwork supervision (max 12).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial licensure within a term: prorated hours, notified in writing at licensure.
rules.alternatives: Current NBCOT certification may be submitted in lieu of CE certificates, except that the 2 ethics hours must still be submitted.
rules.audit_note: Proof of CE credit is submitted with the online renewal. Licensees short of hours get a one-term CE probationary license; failure to make up the hours leads to revocation.

topics.who: Ethics related to OT practice (live or non-live); required even when renewing with NBCOT certification

rules.legal_basis: Regulations Governing Licensure of Occupational Therapists and OTAs, Rules 8.6.1–8.7.4 (amended February 2025); Miss. Code Ann. §73-24-13
rules.notes: Biennial licensure period May 1 – April 30 of even-numbered years (current period ends April 30, 2028). 1 CEU = 10 contact hours.
